build_stft_magnitude_spectrogram: build a python module that performs STFT on an audio signal and returns the magnitude spectrogram
create_spectral_convergence_loss: create a SpectralConvergenceLoss module to compute normalized Frobenius norm between predicted and ground truth magnitude spectrograms
create_log_stft_magnitude_loss: create a LogSTFTMagnitudeLoss module to compute L1 loss between log magnitude spectrograms of predicted and ground truth signals
build_stft_loss: build an STFTLoss module that computes both spectral convergence and log magnitude loss for audio signals
create_multi_resolution_stft_loss: create a MultiResolutionSTFTLoss module that averages STFT losses across multiple FFT resolutions for audio quality evaluation
